{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Run golangci-lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  # Needed by golangci-lint-action's only-new-issues to read the PR diff.
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  golangci-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out code into the Go module directory
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9
        with:
          version: v2.12.2
          only-new-issues: true", "rationale": "The repository is a Go project (go.mod and go.sum are present) and the lint workflow runs on every pull request, repeatedly fetching Go module dependencies. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by measured experiment evidence showing elapsed-time savings with unchanged check outcomes. Adding a single actions/cache step for the Go module cache, keyed on go.mod/go.sum, preserves the existing golangci-lint check, its permissions, and required-check behavior while reducing repeated dependency fetch time on subsequent PR runs.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
